slides.title: Dekho [[jodwa]] kaun
slides.note: Same email, alag ID. Signup **do baar** ho gaya 🤦

slides.title: Step 1: [[dhundo]]
slides.code:
SELECT email, COUNT(*)
FROM users
GROUP BY email
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;
slides.note: GROUP BY se email ke dabbe, **HAVING** se sirf bhare hue dabbe

slides.title: Step 2: [[number]] do
rn = 1 [[rakho]]
slides.note: ORDER BY id → **sabse purana** record bachega

slides.title: Step 3: [[hatao]]
slides.code:
DELETE FROM users
WHERE id IN (
 SELECT id FROM (
  SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER
   (PARTITION BY email
    ORDER BY id) AS rn
  FROM users) t
 WHERE rn > 1);
slides.note: Extra wrapper **t** = MySQL ka "same table" error se bachao

slides.right:
Pehle backup + SELECT check,
phir DELETE (transaction mein)
slides.why: DELETE ka **undo button nahi**. Galat WHERE = asli data bhi gaya 💀

caption:
Ek email, do baar? Doppelganger pakdo 👯

Duplicates dhundo aur hatao, 3 steps mein!
Is post mein:
✅ GROUP BY + HAVING se duplicates dhundo
✅ ROW_NUMBER se numbering
✅ rn > 1 wale delete
✅ Backup + UNIQUE constraint safety
